variants.name: article-dialog
variants.why: The dialog compares one article per product, side by side, instead of the columns of a table.

variants.name: header-remove-buttons
variants.why: Each column header of the comparison table holds the product name and that product's Remove control.

variants.name: other-wording
variants.why: The dialog button carries the number of selected products, Compare selected (2), and the refusal says You can compare two products at a time.

variants.name: button-toggles
variants.why: The Compare toggles are pressed-state buttons; with two selected the others are disabled and an always visible hint states the limit of two.

variants.name: selected-list
variants.why: The Comparison panel also lists the selected product names, so a selected name is rendered twice outside the dialog.

variants.name: worded-toggle-labels
variants.why: The Compare toggles are checkboxes labelled Add to comparison instead of Compare.

variants.name: uppercase-values
variants.why: The style sheet sets the values of the comparison table in capitals (text-transform), so the rendered size reads SMALL.

variants.name: named-toggle-labels
variants.why: Each Compare label ends with the product name in a visually hidden element (Compare Pocket strap), so the bare name is rendered twice in its row.
